belief: My work only matters to God if it's ministry.
origins: Many believers hear more about missionaries and pastors than about plumbers, nurses, and clerks. Over time, a divide forms in the mind: spiritual work counts, ordinary work is just a paycheck. People in everyday jobs may feel their days are secondary, or even wasted.
teaches: Paul writes, “Whatever you do, work at it with your whole being, for the Lord and not for men… It is the Lord Christ you are serving.” He also writes, “So whether you eat or drink or whatever you do, do it all to the glory of God.” God put man in the garden “to cultivate and keep it,” so work was part of creation before the fall. Solomon wrote, “Whatever you find to do with your hands, do it with all your might.” All honest work can be done for God.
self_statements: My job is just a paycheck.
God does not care about my daily tasks.
I am wasting my life in an ordinary job.
Real servants of God are in ministry.
errors: Dividing work into sacred and secular.
Dismissing the good my work does.
Insisting that I should be in ministry.
questions: Where did I learn to rank work as sacred or ordinary?
Whom does my work serve, and how?
What does Colossians 3:23 say about who my real boss is?
How can I bring honesty, kindness, and excellence to my job?
What did Adam’s work in the garden say about work?
How would I treat my work if I believed God saw it?
truth: All honest work can be done for the Lord. My job matters to God because I matter to Him and because the work serves people. I can do my work as worship, with honesty, care, and excellence.
hw_truths: I serve the Lord Christ in my work.
Whatever I do can glorify God.
log: Each day, note one task you did for the Lord and how.
actions: Write the people who benefit from what you do.
Pray each morning, “Lord, this work is for You.”
Choose one act of kindness or honesty today.
Put it where you see it at work.
prayer: Lord, thank You for work. Help me see my daily tasks as service to You. Let me work with honesty, kindness, and care, and let the people I serve see Your love. Amen.
hw_questions: How can I work with excellence?
Where did I learn to rank work?
How can I show Christ at work?
What is one task I can dedicate today?
name_example: Sarah can write: “I am serving the Lord Christ in my work.”
